before.heuristic: current eval runner faithfulness scoring using _tokens from app/faithfulness.py
before.description: Token overlap between expected evidence and retrieved chunks, filtering stopwords. Edge cases: no-answer queries may return false positives; hallucination may go undetected when surface tokens match.
before.limitation: Cannot distinguish between legitimate answers and hallucinated content that uses similar terminology; no-answer detection relies on answerable_match flag which may be inconsistent with faithfulness score

after.heuristic: tightened no-answer and hallucination diagnostics with explicit before/after comparison
after.description: Enhanced scoring that separately tracks: (1) no-answer detection when expected_answerable=False, (2) hallucination flagging when faithfulness >= threshold but answerable_match=False, (3) hops_match verification across multi-hop queries
